answer: Entry costs a bonded watch, not a copied key. You lock 1.96 POA and weld one ferrous collar onto reef piling P-8. The collar must broadcast a 15-byte signal chip every 24 minutes for 11 hours; each chip folds the last hash plus a fresh height nonce. Harbor clerks verify the chain against the lock tx and a public sonar reel. If two collars appear on P-8, a chip repeats, or any gap exceeds 31 minutes, 0.58 POA is slashed and P-8 is barred for ten epochs.
